dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Blitzara, Twirly-Whirly! It's been a while!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: You guys look like you've gotten a bit rounder... or should Paimon say, stronger? Goes to show that you've been listening to Haniyyah and Souka, eating all your meals, and sleeping on time.
